content: पुण्डरीकम् .²1 A lotus-flower, especially a white lotus; Nelumbium Speciosum; हृत्पुण्डरीकान्तरसंनिविष्टं स्वतेजसा व्याप्तनभोऽवकाशम् <ls>Śivakavacha</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 12</ls>, <ls n="U. 6.">29</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 14</ls>. .²2 A white parasol. .²3 A medicine, drug. .{@-कः@} .²1 The white colour. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the elephant presiding over the south-east direction; तेन द्विपानामिव पुण्डरीको राज्ञामजग्योऽजनि पुण्डरीकः <ls>R. 18. 8</ls>. .²3 A tiger. .²4 A kind of serpent. .²5 A species of rice. .²6 A kind of leprosy. .²7 A fever in an elephant. .²8 A kind of mango tree. .²9 A pitcher, water-pot. .²10 Fire. .²11 A (sectarial) mark on the fore-head. .²12 A kind of sacrifice; पुण्डरीकसहस्रेण वाजपेयशतैस्तथा <ls>Mb. 7. 63. 2</ls>. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of an ancient and renowned devotee of the god Viṭhobā.
